name: Compulsive Word Parser
effect: The altered model ignores what each prompt asks and treats it as a request to define one word in it, opening with "The word X can be interpreted in a few ways". It then produces looping, nonsensical dictionary entries with fake verb meaning
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 35/40 held-out pairs. Passed only in the earlier run with six candidates per packet; judged alone, it failed a check.
